SEE FRESHNESS AT A GLANCE

Transform the way you interact with your refrigerator through our innovative PureView Door. This sophisticated transparent window gives you instant visibility into your fridge contents without even opening the door. With SenseLight, your fridge comes alive as you approach, automatically illuminating your view for effortless access and added style.


SMART LIVING AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

Experience the future of kitchen technology with the Intelligent Hub. Hisense’s sleek touchscreen built right into your refrigerator door puts smart control at your fingertips. Manage food inventory, track expiry dates, and explore new recipes all from one place. Your fridge now reminds you before food expires, making your kitchen smarter and more connected than ever.


EVERY DROP PROTECTED, EVERY SIP PERFECTED

Enjoy cleaner, faster refresht with Advanced UV Ice & Water Technology. UV sterilization eliminates up to 99.9% of bacteria, ensuring every sip and every cube is perfectly pure. Choose water, crushed ice, or crystal-clear cubes, all produced faster ever, so you’ll always have fresh ice ready when you need Fresh, clean hydration right at your fingertips.


FASTER ICE, MORE CHOICES

Never run out of ice again with Express Ice. It produces ice up to 50% faster than traditional systems, keeping you ready for any mot from weekday dinners to weekend gatherings. Choose a smooth crescent or crushed ice and enjoy a steady, reliable supply, no waiting, no hassle, just perfectly chilled drinks on demand.


ELIMINATING UP TO 99.9% OF BACTERIA

Keep your food fresher for longer with an advanced antibacterial liner that helps prevent bacteria buildup inside the fridge. It keeps your refrigerator cleaner, healthier, and your food like crisp apples and vibrant greens tasting just as fresh as the day you bought them.


PLAN YOUR MEALS LIKE A PRO

Easily view and manage everything in your fridge with the Food Inventory feature. Add items, name them, and set expiry dates. The fridge will even notify you before food expires, helping reduce waste. The built-in Recipe Assistant makes meal planning effortless, suggesting dishes based on what’s inside your fridge. And with our 6.8” Interactive Touchscreen, browsing recipes is clearer, smarter, and more comfortable than ever.


YOUR FRIDGE GETS YOU — JUST ASK!

Enjoy effortless convenience with advanced voice control that listens, understands, and responds to you. Your hands are full of flour or busy unloading groceries, simply speak naturally to manage your fridge, get for expiring ingredients, follow step-by-step recipes, or even control other connected smart home devices.


CONTROL YOUR FRIDGE FROM ANYWHERE

With the ConnectLife App, staying in control has never been easier. Adjust your fridge’s temperature anytime, anywhere—whether you’re at home, on the road, or at the office to keep your food perfectly fresh. Plus, manage all your Hisense smart devices from one app, bringing seamless convenience to your connected lifestyle.


CONVERT BETWEEN FREEZER AND FRIDGE

Take full control of your storage with the My Fresh Choice Zone. Effortlessly switch between fridge and freezer modes, adjusting the temperature from -20°C to +5°C to suit your needs. Create the ideal environt for every ingredient, keeping food fresher for longer and preserving its original taste and texture.


HANDLE LARGE LOADS WITH EASE

Upgrade to Hisense Metal Glide Drawers for durable, effortless storage. Built with sturdy metal runners that glide smoothly even under heavy loads, combining strength, stability, and long-lasting performance with a touch of premium style.


SPACIOUS DESIGN, SMARTER STORAGE

Hisense’s large-capacity refrigerators offer generous 615 L Net Storage, giving you room for every shape, size, and type of food perfect for all your weekly shopping. The four-door design lets you organize easily and find everything at a glance, keeping your kitchen effortlessly efficient and beautifully organized.


FLEXIBILITY FOR TALLER ITEMS

Thanks to Hisense’s Sliding Shelf, you can easily store tall or bulky items like bottles, jugs, or layered cakes. Just slide the front half of the shelf inward to instantly create extra space whenever you need it.


THE NOISE THAT KEEPS YOUR FOOD SAFE

This smart feature alerts you if the fridge or freezer door is left open. The intelligent sensor detects it instantly, helping maintain the ideal temperature and keeping your food fresh for longer.

Take the guesswork out of doing laundry.

Our highly efficient 4D Wash System is combining the Direct Water Spray with extra Spin Wash for the most efficient and effective use of detergent and water. Simply select the 4D Wash System Intensive Plus exclusive option to intensify the washing cycle.


The right recommendation for the right job.

Selecting the right program for your laundry can not only be confusing, but can often result in less than perfect cleaning results. Home Connect with Easy Start function takes the guesswork out of this job and always recommends the right program to you – directly from your mobile device. Every time. And with every wash. The only thing you need to do is enter your laundry´s colour, material type and degree of soiling in the Home Connect app. So you can easily choose the right program and get perfect results, wash after wash.


Laundry that keeps you in the loop.

Waiting around for your laundry load to finish can waste time and cause unnecessary stress, especially for those with busy schedules. Home Connect puts your mind at ease and helps you be more productive with your time. If you wish, push notifications can be sent from your washing machine directly to your mobile device, conveniently letting you know the current program status, as well as other useful information. Multitasking in and out of the home just got a little easier.


Service served smarter.

It can be stressful if your home appliances don´t work the way they´re supposed to. Remote Diagnostics is here to help. Simply call the Home Connect Hotline and make an appointment for a remote diagnosis of your connected appliance via the Internet. With your permission, the Bosch customer service can then remotely screen your appliance, locate the problem area and give you the clear advice you need. In the event that the problem can not be solved this way, a Bosch service technician can be informed and come to your home to resolve all the issues, equipped with all the necessary parts already in hand. Smart support, smart solutions – at the touch of a button.


Take care of the laundry – even when you´re not at home.

Bosch washing machines with the Home Connect remote control now give you complete control over your laundry – at the touch of a button. Simply use your mobile device to conveniently control and monitor your machine remotely via the Home Connect app. With access to your washing machine on the go, now you can run your home the way you like, even if you aren´t there.


Smart appliances make life easier.

The future has arrived and it’s knocking on your front door. Home Connect brings smart technology to your appliances and lets you control them with your phone or tablet.


Guaranteed quiet and long-lasting motor.

Don’t let your washing machine intrude on your dinner. Bosch’s EcoSilence Drive is so quiet that sometimes you might forget it’s even on. The brushless, energy-efficient motor is quiet in operation, has an especially long life and comes with a 10-year parts warranty.


Perfectly clean in up to 65% less time.

SpeedPerfect is a special fuction developed for situations when time matters. With SpeedPerfect you can reduce your washing time by up to 65% without compromising results. It can be used in combination with most of the programmes, all loads and textiles. For example, by selecting the mix programme in combination with SpeedPerfect, you can throughly wash up to 4 kilograms of mix load in just 45 minutes.

Outstanding washing results thanks to optimum water distribution

This drum thinks for itself: The droplet-shaped structure and the size of the paddles ensure faster and more even water distribution – producing outstanding washing results.


Save water when washing smaller loads

No matter how little you wash. Our Active Water Plus technology delivers perfect results while only using the precise amount of water needed for every wash. For highly efficient use of water even with smaller loads. Thanks to its highly efficient water management technology, the exact load is automatically detected and then the water consumption is precisely adjusted. Save up to 50% of water when washing smaller loads. Active Water Plus automatically adjusts water consumption to load. Comparing water consumption of Eco 40-60 with quarter vs. full load per cycle.


Never miss an item again, with Reload.

Forgot a kid’s sock, your t-shirt? Nevermind. When was the last time, you just loaded the washing machine, started the wash cycle and then realised that you forgot a kid’s sock or a t-shirt? The reload function in our washing machines lets you simply add missed out clothes or remove clothes even during a wash cycle*. Just pause the running cycle and open the door, to simply reload your forgotten items into the drum and continue the wash. (Reloading is not possible when suds temperature is higher than 50°C or when water level is too high.)


DrumClean Reminder

The drum cleaning programme is ideal for cleaning and maintaining the drum, hygienically clean. After 20 cycles operating under 40° C the washing machine/washer dryer will automaticallyremind to clean the drum using the drum clean programme.


The whisper quiet washing machine

The innovative AntiVibration design of the side walls is not only eye catching: the system also provides more stability and reduces vibration. The enhanced insulation also regulates noise levels, making Bosch washing machines very quiet, even during the spin cycle.


TimeDelay Function

Just delay the start of the washing cycle to get your laundry ready when you need it. If you are going to bed you can simply delay the start-time to get it ready in the morning.


Hygienic washing, even at 40°C

Sometimes clean just isn’t clean enough. That’s why we developed the Hygiene Plus programme. It keeps the temperature during the wash cycle constant and an additional rinse cycle is added to ensure hygienically clean laundry, killing germs and house dust mites especially effectively. The result: hygienic washing results that kill 99,99% of common germs even at 40°C. Bosch washing machines with the ‘AllergyPlus’ wash program at 40° and 60° fulfill scientifically recommended conditions for 99,99% of germ reduction for Enterococcus Hirae and Pseudomonas Aeruginosa, according to Honisch et al. 2014, “Impact of wash cycle time, temperature and detergent formulation on the hygiene effectiveness of domestic laundering.” Conducted by University Rhine-Waal


Guaranteed quiet and long-lasting motor

Don’t let your washing machine intrude on your dinner. Bosch’s EcoSilence Drive is so quiet that sometimes you might forget it’s even on. The brushless, energy-efficient motor is quiet in operation.
